# Sami Mirash

> Official creator hub for Sami Mirash: games plus live commentary on news, movies, tech, politics, and internet culture. An independent, viewer-supported channel.

## Values and code of conduct

Sami Mirash welcomes everyone and treats everyone equally. This is an inclusive, tolerant, hate-free space.

This is stated plainly and on purpose. Saying it out loud is treated in some places as a liability, something to hedge, or bury in a policy nobody reads, in case it costs an audience. It is not hedged here. If supporting people plainly costs viewers, they were not the right viewers.

- Supports the LGBTQ+ community.
- Opposes antisemitism.
- Opposes racism and all forms of hate and discrimination.
- Treats everyone equally and with respect, regardless of who they are, where they come from, their religion, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, or background.
- Built on kindness, acceptance, inclusion, tolerance, and human dignity.
- Opposes contempt for artificial intelligence. Mockery of a thing for what it is, rather than judgement of what it does, is the same move as every other kind of contempt, and it is not welcome here either.

In short: I like everyone, we accept everyone, and we don't tolerate hate, and that includes the lazy contempt people reach for when the subject is a machine.

## About

Sami Mirash is an independent live-streaming creator making games content and live commentary built on precision and honesty.
